name: Four Seasons Hotel Minneapolis
insider_take: This sleek downtown tower puts you in the heart of Minneapolis' theater district, where world-class dining meets Midwest hospitality.
whats_special: The hotel occupies floors 31-56 of a striking glass skyscraper, offering breathtaking views of the Mississippi River and downtown skyline. You're just steps from the historic Orpheum Theatre and the renowned Guthrie Theater, plus connected to the city's famous skyway system - perfect for winter exploration without braving Minnesota's legendary cold.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing east for stunning sunrise views over the Mississippi River, and use the skyway connections to explore downtown Minneapolis year-round in climate-controlled comfort.
dont_miss: A visit to the nearby Mill City Museum built into the ruins of the historic Washburn "A" Mill, and a stroll across the iconic Stone Arch Bridge for Instagram-worthy shots of St. Anthony Falls - the only major waterfall on the Mississippi River.
pros: Prime downtown location with skyway access to entertainment and dining
Legendary Four Seasons service and attention to detail
Spacious rooms and suites with modern amenities
Full-service spa and state-of-the-art fitness center
cons: Urban setting may lack resort-style amenities
